name: gym-app
description: App per loggare gli allenamenti in palestra: serie, timer di recupero, storico, record e grafici. Single-file, offline-first, dati in `localStorage`. Nessun account, nessun server.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
